steps.title: The Market Curves
steps.say: Let's look at how buyers and sellers interact in a market.

steps.title: Market Equilibrium
steps.say: Where the demand and supply curves cross, we find the equilibrium price and quantity.

steps.title: Supply Decreases
steps.say: Now, imagine supply falls due to a shortage. The supply curve shifts to the left.

steps.title: Quiz: Find the New Equilibrium
steps.say: Where is the new equilibrium point? Drag the dot to where the new supply curve meets demand.

steps.title: Result of Supply Falling
steps.say: When supply falls, the lower availability drives prices up, while the traded quantity decreases.

steps.title: Explore on Your Own
steps.say: Try dragging both curves yourself to see how various shifts change market price and quantity!
